title: Impersonating a law enforcement officer in the first degree.
bodyText:
(1) A person commits the offense of impersonating a law enforcement officer in the first degree if, with intent to deceive, the person pretends to be a law enforcement officer and is armed with a firearm.

(2) Impersonating a law enforcement officer in the first degree is a class C felony.
bodyHtml:
[§710-1016.6]  Impersonating a law enforcement officer in the first degree.  (1)  A person commits the offense of impersonating a law enforcement officer in the first degree if, with intent to deceive, the person pretends to be a law enforcement officer and is armed with a firearm.

     (2)  Impersonating a law enforcement officer in the first degree is a class C felony. [L 1987, c 130, pt of §3]
